title: CSKA clinch VTB title
description: Khimki - CSKA 62-80 (0-3) The game without a history. CSKA led from the first minutes and controlled entire game increasing their lead in each quarter. It was a great evening for American guard Cory Higgins (196-89, college: Colorado) who led his team to a victory scoring 23 points. Forward Nikita Kurbanov (202-86) helped adding 12 points, 6 rebounds and 5 assists. The best for the losing side was guard Viacheslav Zaytsev (190-89, agency: Alti Sport) with 22 points and 5 rebounds and American center Malcolm Thomas (206-88, college: San Diego St.) scored 8 points and 7 rebounds. Both coaches used bench players which allowed the starters a little rest for the next games.
imageCaption: CSKA Moscow conquer VTB United League trophy
